BREAKING: Anthropic officially files its S-1 registration statement for an IPO, seeking to list on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol $ANT.

FULL SUMMARY OF ANTHROPIC'S S-1 FILING:

1. Anthropic posted H1 2026 revenue of $16.3 billion with a net loss of $80.7 billion

2. Anthropic says it does not expect to pay a dividend "in the foreseeable future"

3. Expects to spend up to $120.5 billion on SpaceXAI and Nvidia compute

4. Expects to spend up to $114.5 billion with Google through 2033

5. Revenue growth rate "may not be sustainable" and "may decrease"

6. May be required to seek additional financing "sooner than expected"

7. 5% of Anthropic's shares will go to the "Anthropic Public Benefit Fund"

8. S-1 includes warnings of AI's "catastrophic existential risks to humanity"

Markets currently expect Anthropic to raise as much as $100 billion at a valuation of ~$2 trillion.

The company is reportedly targeting an IPO in the week of November 16th.

BREAKING: Flavio Bolsonaro says he will ask for Brazil’s presidential election to be annulled for tonight's historic defeat.

The opposition candidate called what happened in Brazil today "unacceptable," saying the rules were changed "in the middle of the game."

Something has to give, as October 28th is historically the best day of the year. 

This day falls on this Wednesday and that is also a Fed meeting. Under Kevin Warsh we've seen the S&P 500 fall 1.21% in June, 1.52% in July, and 0.45% in September. 

Which history will repeat? https://t.co/1ow3yfDPzw

BREAKING: In an unprecedented comeback, Brazil's President Lula da Silva has defeated Flavio Bolsonaro, securing a 4th term in office.

Lula is officially the first presidential candidate in Brazil's modern democratic history to lose the first round of voting and go on to win the runoff.

Prior to the election, Lula's implied odds of victory had fallen as low as 10%.

This marks one of the most remarkable political comebacks in Brazil's history.
